title: Pass rates after exam webcasting: a descriptive district analysis of Karnataka's SSLC examination, 2014-2026
description: Code, derived district-level data, results and documentation for a descriptive analysis of pass rates in Karnataka's Class 10 board examination (SSLC) across the 34 educational districts, 2014-2026, around the March 2024 introduction of live webcasting of every examination centre. The design is descriptive: the data cannot separate the effect of webcasting from other simultaneous changes (grace marks, a three-exam structure).
